exclusions: Ordinary language, arithmetic, control-flow, input/output, storage and compiler-limit instructions are not selected merely because the manual explains code.
Variable/function naming restrictions specify syntax and numeric modes; they do not establish a position about self-explanatory naming.
Hollerith English fields and blank/carriage-control conventions describe runtime data/output, not comments. The complete commented program retains its connected output explanation.
DIMENSION, EQUIVALENCE and FREQUENCY provide information consumed by the compiler; their non-executability does not make them comments.
Operational manuals, HALT identifiers, generated storage descriptions, and the handwritten numeric correction on page 41 are not authored source-code comments.
The unmarked MORE PROGRAM on page 50 is an editorial code placeholder, not inferred to be an inline comment.
The damaged base code-sheet spans p009:17-27 and p048:21-72 are replaced in the extraction by separately supplied visual transcriptions; OCR fragments are not labeled faithful code.
